provenance.notes: SWE-bench Multilingual 63.0, SWE-bench Pro 45.96. Kwaipilot report their own base model, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, at 64.40 on the same harness — where Alibaba report 73.4 for it. The two vendors' harnesses disagree by nine points on an identical model, so compare the uplift within this row, not across vendors.
Well behind Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B (68.5) at the same size and active-parameter count — this model is tuned for patch generation more than for long terminal sessions.
